correctness.rationale: Exact independent-child binomial recursion holds at every finite branching factor and modal depth. Under odd branching the fair binomial tail has no ties. Under even branching its centered tie probability is asymptotically 1/sqrt(2 pi n); the triangular-array binomial CLT yields the depth-two Phi(sqrt(2/pi)) limit, and Hoeffding yields depth-three saturation and propagates fixed deeper limits. The strict probabilities equal the complements exactly by binomial tail symmetry. For noncentral ratios Hoeffding proves deterministic limits. All boundary cases r=0,1 were inspected. Direct finite enumeration and separate rational recurrence give reproducible corroboration but are not used as infinite proofs.

This is an exact motivated classification rather than an arbitrary finite numerical exercise.
